## [`product/tests/test_multi_title.py`](product/tests/test_multi_title.py)

**31 tests, all green.** Organised into 7 test classes across 3 titles.

### Title corpus & per-title contract rules

| Title | Contract deal | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| **Echoes of Eternity** | SAG-AFTRA SVOD, US/ROW | `PER_STREAM_MINUTE` $0.0015/min + `THRESHOLD_TRIGGER` at 5 M min |
| **Neon Horizon** | DACH AVOD/SVOD + Broadcast | `REVENUE_SHARE` 15 % (AVOD+SVOD) + `FLAT_FEE_PER_PLAY` €8/play (Broadcast) |
| **Quantum Fallback** | Global Broadcast-first | `MINIMUM_GUARANTEE` $500 k + `THRESHOLD_TRIGGER` at 10 M min @ $0.002/min |

### Test classes

| Class | What it proves |
|---|---|
| `TestEchoesContractRules` | Rule-to-event matching, ROW catch-all, broadcast exclusion |
| `TestNeonContractRules` | Dual-channel scoping, DACH territory filtering, rate/currency fields |
| `TestQuantumContractRules` | MG rule type, 10 M threshold value, broadcast ROW matching |
| `TestEchoesEngine` | 5-event pre-threshold accrual, hero moment on event 6, settlement PENDING→APPROVED workflow, audit integrity |
| `TestEchoesIdempotency` | Same event submitted twice → `duplicate_ignored: True`, count stays at 1 |
| `TestNeonEngine` | Revenue-share engine records all events without minting a notice; US event contributes zero audit entries |
| `TestCrossTitleIsolation` | Separate engine instances share no state; Echoes hero moment does not affect Quantum engine; notice IDs are distinct |
